annotations.title: Update the page on the TV

description: Update a page shown with show_html. With data, the page stays and receives a window "message" event {type:"teleq:update", data} (no reload, no flicker; up to 64 KB of JSON). With html, the page is replaced (a short reload). Only works while that page is still on screen.

data.description: New values for the page, delivered as message event data.

html.description: Optional replacement HTML document (up to 262144 characters).

id.description: The id returned by the show_* call that put the content up.

name: update_html
title: Update the page on the TV
